1250
Don’t use a stepper for large or exact numbers — nobody taps + a thousand times. Use Text field (3.2) with a numeric keyboard.
Do
2
On touch screens use L (56 px) or at least M (44 px) so both buttons are easy to hit.
Don't
2
Don’t use S on mobile: 36 px is below the 44 px touch target, and − / + sit too close together.
